# Pragmatic @ Stage 17 — Meta-cross Violet

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Expression on this line

Pragmatic capacity at Order 16 is the theoretical ceiling: the distinction between problem
and solution, between means and ends, between method and outcome, dissolves into a single
undivided process. All prior practical paradigms — engineering, indigenous, contemplative, and
their cross-paradigmatic hybrids — are held not as coordinated-but-distinct but as a single
undivided field.

As with all Stage 17 cells, this is a theoretical extrapolation.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** problem and solution experienced as a single undivided process.\n- **UR:** (if observable at all) practical functioning without a traceable distinction between
  means and ends.\n- **LL:** if any collective correlate exists, it would be a contemplative tradition that has
  cultivated this dissolution.\n- **LR:** no clearly identified external artifact yet.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** claiming to have transcended the problem/solution distinction.\n- **Dark allergy:** not applicable.\n- **Golden addiction:** asserting this order based on a felt sense.\n- **Golden allergy:** dismissing the entire order as mysticism.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **No established positive diagnostic exists.**\n- **Absence-of-seam as a claim, not a proof.**\n- **Extrapolation flag:** this cell's status should be periodically revisited.

## Sources, joints, open questions

(wu-wei as means/ends dissolution — aspirational); Dewey, *Art as Experience* (experience
as undivided practical-aesthetic whole — aspirational).\n**Open joints:** Is Order 16 a coherent, reachable pragmatic state, or an artifact of
